facts.fact: Decree D/2025/053 of 14 April 2025 cites Law L/2020/027/AN of 19 December 2020 on the right of access to public information among the laws it is made under.
facts.system: Loi L/2020/027/AN portant Droit d'Accès à l'Information Publique

GIN.note: The document states nothing about addressing.

facts.fact: Decree D/2025/053 states one body, the organ in charge of civil status and identification, holds both the national civil-status register and the national register of natural persons, keyed by the personal identification number (NPI).
facts.system: registre national de l'état civil and registre national des personnes physiques (NPI)

systems.owner: organe en charge de l'état civil et de l'identification
organe en charge de l'état civil et de l'identification

GIN.note: The document states nothing about a business register.
The decree allows paper or electronic declaration and storage but states no digital system procured, piloted or in service.
The decree refers to the authority in charge of personal data protection without naming it or saying it is appointed.
The decree covers civil-status and identification data only and states nothing on a general data protection law.
It mentions the NPI and a law on identification of natural persons without naming, dating or describing that law.
The document states nothing about a voters' roll.
It does not say the NPI is given at birth registration.
The document states nothing about land registration.
The document states nothing about local government office connections.
The document states nothing about police station records.

facts.fact: Decree D/2025/053 provides for the national register of natural persons, with practical implementation measures left to PN-RAVEC (Art. 39).
